Markets.title: Asia steps up stock rescue efforts after Wall Street rout
Markets.summary: Asian nations are implementing new financial strategies to combat declining stock markets following a Wall Street rout. Specifically, China is reducing margin requirements to free up about 400 billion yuan, while South Korea and Taiwan are introducing measures to reduce market volatility and reinforce interventions.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares cautious as AI selloff fears persist despite US futures rebound
Markets.summary: Asian shares remained cautious amid ongoing fears of an artificial intelligence selloff, even as U.S. stock futures rebounded. Meanwhile, Asian trading saw Brent crude decline while spot gold rallied following five consecutive days of losses.

Markets.title: South Korea prepares market stabilisation funds after KOSPI hits 10-month low
Markets.summary: South Korea's finance ministry is preparing to activate market stabilisation funds after the KOSPI index hit a 10-month low. Officials convened an emergency meeting to discuss strategies for restoring investor confidence, including temporary regulations on stock buyback limits for public companies.

Markets.title: Crude oil futures brace for OPEC+ output decision amid supply glut concerns: Analysts
Markets.summary: Crude oil futures face increased volatility ahead of the upcoming OPEC+ meeting and inventory reports from the US. Persistent concerns regarding a global supply surplus are currently outweighing the impact of geopolitical tensions in West Asia.

Markets.title: Why gold’s five-year winning streak is under threat after dramatic selloff
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped to about $3,510 an ounce after reaching a record $5,594.82 earlier in 2026. This dramatic selloff puts the metal on track for its first annual loss in five years due to a stronger dollar, higher bond yields, and weaker safe-haven demand.

Markets.title: InvIT IPO rush gathers pace; 4-5 private trusts likely to go public by Mar 2027
Markets.summary: Four to five private Infrastructure Investment Trusts plan to launch public offerings to raise Rs 17,000 crore by March 2027. Major firms like Brookfield and Investcorp are preparing to transition to these public InvITs to fund infrastructure development.

Geo-Political.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
Geo-Political.summary: Climate negotiations at COP31 collapsed without a major agreement. The talks failed after countries disagreed over whether to include a specific mention of fossil fuels in the deal.

Geo-Political.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
Geo-Political.summary: Climate negotiations at COP31 collapsed after breaking down two days past their scheduled conclusion. These talks are now the longest-running in the history of the summit without a deal.

Geo-Political.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian ship stopped at a Libyan port for fuel and supplies was damaged by an explosion. Officials state the blast was caused by a suspected drone attack.

Geo-Political.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC reports from a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region following Russian strikes. Residents there are actively searching for people who are missing after the attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
Geo-Political.summary: A Russia-bound ship was towed away following a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland. Finnish defense forces state that Ukraine likely conducted the strike, though Kyiv has not yet commented.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea's education minister resigned after last-minute efforts to prevent AI-assisted cheating caused chaos during the college entrance exam. Choi Kyo-jin admitted responsibility for the disruption and stepped down from his position.

AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code by providing evidence-backed answers about app mechanics.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: Protein prices bite as food inflation squeezes Indian households
Data & Insights.summary: Food inflation in India has more than doubled since April due to soaring prices. Essential protein sources, including milk, pulses, meats, and eggs, are driving this financial squeeze on households.

Data & Insights.title: Gold prices fall below $4,000: Could bullion slide further to $3,500 as higher US interest rates weigh on demand?
Data & Insights.summary: Gold prices have dropped below $4,000 per ounce due to higher US interest rates, rising bond yields, and a stronger dollar. Analysts at StoneX warn that the metal could fall further to support levels between $3,500 and $3,600.

Data & Insights.title: The El Niño polycrisis: How a severe drought is squeezing Indian farms, ethanol plants and your kitchen budget
Data & Insights.summary: El Niño-driven drought and low reservoir levels have slowed winter crop planting across India. This agricultural strain is shrinking food supplies and increasing the risk of higher inflation for household budgets.

Data & Insights.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO, credit growth, IFFI event: key highlights in the week ahead
Data & Insights.summary: The upcoming week will feature major economic events, including the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO and updates on credit growth. Markets will also monitor other key data releases and the IFFI event.

Data & Insights.title: Vedanta's Anil Agarwal pitches PSU privatisation, 3-fold employment growth and self-certification
Data & Insights.summary: Vedanta Chairman Anil Agarwal has advocated for the private management of government-owned companies without reducing employee headcount. He also proposed achieving a threefold increase in employment and implementing self-certification.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi's ‘insatiable hunger for concessions’ remark rattles India Inc; companies prepare to defend jobs, salary growth
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi criticized India Inc's constant demand for government concessions during a recent address. In response, corporate executives are preparing to defend their hiring and salary growth amid fears that future tax breaks will be rejected.

India.title: Nepal PM Balen Shah India Visit LIVE Updates: Nepal PM To Meet PM Modi Today, Bilateral Ties On Agenda
India.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday for a two-day state visit to India. He is scheduled to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi today to discuss bilateral ties.

India.title: Hyderabad Police Probe Hoax Threat Email Warning of 26/11-Like Attack
India.summary: Hyderabad police are investigating a hoax email that threatened a 26/11-style Mumbai attack. The message specifically named Kachiguda railway station and a nearby hotel as potential targets.

India.title: Between Nehru And Netanyahu, Rahul Gandhi Faces An Uncomfortable Question
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi endorsed maintaining strong ties with Israel by citing India's defense requirements and national interests. This stance highlights a divergence between his position and India's historical foreign policy under Jawaharlal Nehru.

India.title: Bag With Rs 55-Lakh Gold Jewellery Swapped In Delhi Recovered From Bengaluru
India.summary: A bag containing Rs 55 lakh worth of gold jewellery was stolen after being swapped at the ISBT Kashmiri Gate terminal in Delhi on November 12. Police successfully recovered the stolen valuables from Bengaluru following the complaint filed by Amrit Raj Verma.

India.title: MPs Who Broke Away From Mamata Banerjee Expand Their Party NCPI Into Rural Bengal
India.summary: Twenty TMC MPs who left Mamata Banerjee's party after its election loss to the BJP have expanded their newly formed Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI). Multiple rural panchayat bodies in West Bengal have now broken away from the TMC to join the NCPI.

India.title: 'Kill Tony' To 'Latent' To 'Cockroach Club': CJP's Next Move In Pop Culture-Coded Politics
India.summary: The Cockroach Janta Party has launched a new performance platform called 'Cockroach Club'. This political venture draws inspiration from the self-effacing show 'India's Got Latent' to engage in pop culture-coded politics.

General.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
General.summary: Climate talks at COP31 collapsed without a major agreement due to deep divisions over mentioning fossil fuels. Negotiations failed after countries could not resolve disputes regarding how to address the future of fossil fuel use.

General.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
General.summary: COP31 climate negotiations have broken down after becoming the longest-running talks in the summit's history. The collapse occurred two days after the scheduled end of the conference.

General.title: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better'
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham will tell MPs that the EU deal agreed on Friday offers a choice between a broken status quo and change. He will argue that the landmark agreement has the potential to make the next decade much better.

General.title: Can AI spot breast cancer earlier? NHS launches world's largest trial to find out
General.summary: The NHS has launched the world's largest trial to test whether artificial intelligence can spot breast cancer earlier during routine screenings. Researchers hope the technology will improve detection rates and help ease pressure on the healthcare system.

General.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
General.summary: Rescuers pulled a 7-year-old boy alive from the rubble of a residential building in Ukraine following a Russian strike. The attack left six people dead, and rescue efforts are ongoing to find the missing.

General.title: Boss of British Gas owner Centrica 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
General.summary: Centrica boss Chris O'Shea is deeply concerned that soaring energy bills will cause more people to struggle with payments when prices rise in the new year. British Gas's owner warns that the number of customers unable or unwilling to pay will significantly increase.
